FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Eternal Stones Memorials specializes in the design, production, and sale of high-quality monuments and tombstones for cemeteries and memorial sites. Our operations include personalized consultations with clients to understand their needs, detailed planning and design services, and skilled stone cutting and engraving. 

We conduct our business from our retail location in Stone City, where customers can view our extensive selection of stones, styles, and inscriptions. Our craftsmen utilize modern equipment to ensure precision and quality, with a strong emphasis on safety and sanitation throughout our production process.

Additionally, we manage logistics and delivery of monuments to ensure timely installations at designated locations. All of our staff members undergo rigorous training in safety protocols and customer service, enhancing our reputation for reliability within the community. Compliance with local, state, and federal regulations is a priority, ensuring our operations are both legal and ethical. We maintain a transparent relationship with customers by providing clear documentation of all contracts and services, thereby safeguarding both parties’ interests. Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction sets us apart as a trusted provider in the memorial services industry.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any intentional acts or gross negligence and confirms that it fully complies with all applicable local, state, and federal regulations. Additionally, we do not utilize subcontractors without naming and ensuring them on our policy, and we have no history of frequent or unresolved claims that would affect our coverage.

FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: The business experienced a minor loss on 08/15/2022 due to a delivery vehicle accident while transporting a tombstone, causing $1,500 in damage to the vehicle. The claim has been settled and marked as closed.
